title: Alpha big air: slow-mo, camera, blur and muffle now hit together
summary: In Settings → Alpha, air slow-mo, the big-air camera, air blur and music muffle were driven separately (camera/blur eased in during the climb and held to touchdown; slow-mo started only at the apex), so they fired at different times. One apex "moment" (0.2 s ease in, 0.55 s hold, 0.4 s ease out) now drives all of them together, scaled by jump size. Slow-motion drawing now blends by the fixed-step accumulator phase instead of wall-clock segments, which froze and snapped on phones' uneven frames. The air-blur pass is built when its toggle is turned on rather than mid-jump, and uses six taps instead of ten on phones/tablets.
details: atv-game unit tests (all four effects share one envelope frame by frame; slow-mo presenter moves exactly with scaled time at alternating 14.5/21 ms frames, where the old wall-clock blending fails); host Chromium ENV05 browser tests test_engine_air_blur, test_engine_alpha_muffle, test_engine_alpha pass; a host Chromium per-frame trace showed time scale, blur and muffle rising, holding and releasing on the same frames.
limitation: host-only evidence; not yet measured on a physical phone. Particles and other per-step effects still advance at the slowed step rate during slow motion.
